name: Search Session Hotfix
features: SQLite persistence of search sessions (token + results + infinite-scroll cursors)
automatic RAM restore after Gunicorn worker restart (no more 404 on /expand)
frontend session recovery on 404 (localStorage guard, 30 s anti-loop)
latency instrumentation: page= per wave, network/queue/duration per source, raw/parsed/retenus per route
fail-fast retry caps (eBay Retry-After <= 3 s, retail route budget)
